blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — The Iriga City government distributed metal detectors to 51 public schools on Monday to strengthen security and prevent prohibited or potentially dangerous items on school campuses. Mayor Wilfredo Rex Cuba Oliva led the distribution during the Department of Education (DepEd) Iriga City Division Management Committee meeting. Oliva turned over the devices to school principals. READ: Metal detectors, CCTV to be installed as security measure in Albay school The city government said it provided the Schools Division Office with an additional metal detector.
